# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Participants are expected to be respectful, constructive, and considerate.
Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, doxxing, and deliberately
disruptive behavior are not welcome.

## Reporting

Report conduct problems privately to the repository maintainers through the
contact details on the maintainer's GitHub profile. Security vulnerabilities
must be reported through the private process in [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

Maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, or restrict participation
when necessary to keep the project safe and useful.
